ModMetaData.name: Force Outfit Change
ModMetaData.author: ForceOutfitChange Mod Team
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a button to the Assign tab that allows you to force colonists to immediately change their outfit to match their assigned apparel policy.
Features: - Force outfit change button next to each colonist's apparel policy in the Assign tab - Wakes sleeping colonists and interrupts their current task - Click and drag functionality to apply to multiple colonists at once - Useful for quickly switching to battle gear when raids arrive
This mod is designed to be compatible with other mods and uses Harmony for minimal conflicts.
